messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

Mercedes

varun balakrishna at mercedes | contineu.ai | eth zurich. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/varunbalakrishna
Yes

Liked computer vision in the industry

done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

eth zurich credentials + mercedes experience + computer vision expertise... that's a combo that makes recruiters drool

roles will start flowing in. the kind where they actually understand what you do instead of asking "can you build a website?"
